t1.note: Sit your partner down in front of you and let the tape talk to them. When they have a drawing, play tape 2.

t2.note: Two fingers on your temple. Tell them, don't ask. Wait for the answer, then play tape 3.
t2.say: There is an A in your word.

t3y.note: Fingers on your temple. Have them picture the whole word again. Then play tape 4.

t3n.note: That was the test letter. Ask them to focus harder. Then play tape 4.

t4yy.note: A slow breath, both of you. Be a little less certain. Then play tape 5.

t4yn.note: Lower your hand. Say it firmly. Agree or correct, either is fine. Then play tape 5.
t4yn.say: What you drew is not a living thing.

t4ny.note: Lower your hand. Have them see it in front of them, life size. Then play tape 5.

t4nn.note: A picture thinker. Forget the letters. Have them look at the thing itself. Then play tape 5.

t5s.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Skip tape 6. Play the red tape.
t5s.say: I'm not sure about this one. Is there an S?

t5r.note: The letters are finished. Lower your hand. Then play tape 6.

t5hold.note: Hold out your hands, palms up. Then play tape 6.
t5hold.say: Could you pick it up and hold it in your hands?

t5man.note: Don't ask anything else. Skip tape 6. Play the red tape.

t5live.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Skip tape 6. Play the red tape.

t5sun.note: Don't ask anything else. Skip tape 6. Play the red tape.

t6home.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Play the red tape.
t6home.say: Is there one in your home?

t6hard.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Play the red tape.

t6own.note: Whatever they answer, don't say a word. Play the red tape.
